features.name: parcel_area_m2
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.missing_value: absent with source_value_missing or invalid_geometry; never zero

features.name: building_footprint_m2
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: area(intersection(unit geometry, union(deduplicated resolved building footprints)))
features.missing_value: absent when building resolution is incomplete; never zero

features.name: footprint_ratio
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.missing_value: absent if either input is absent or parcel area is zero

features.name: unbuilt_area_proxy_m2
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.missing_value: absent if either input is absent; never presented as constructible area

features.name: parcel_compactness
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.missing_value: absent for empty geometry or zero perimeter

features.name: parcel_width_proxy_m
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: shortest non-zero edge of minimum rotated rectangle around unit geometry

features.name: building_boundary_distance_m
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: minimum distance between resolved building union and unit boundary
features.missing_value: absent when no certain building is resolved

features.name: road_access_proxy
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: length(unit boundary intersect buffer(public road geometry, configured threshold))
features.missing_value: absent when accepted road coverage is unavailable; never proves legal access

features.name: building_count
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: count(distinct certain resolved physical buildings, after source deduplication)
features.missing_value: absent when building resolution is incomplete; never zero

features.name: light_construction_ratio
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: area(union(BD TOPO light construction footprints)) / LAND-002
features.missing_value: absent when BD TOPO is unavailable or building footprint is zero

features.name: building_use
features.subject: Building
features.formula: highest-priority observed use; retain contradictions in provenance
features.missing_value: absent when no observed value exists; predictions are excluded

features.name: building_height_m
features.subject: Building
features.missing_value: absent when no observed value exists

features.name: dwelling_count_observed
features.subject: Building
features.formula: highest-priority observed dwelling count without imputation
features.missing_value: absent when no observed value exists
